answer: Cap influence by funding root, not by account: trace every identity's stake back to the wallet that first funded it, and all identities sharing one root split a single combined weight cap. A farm can bridge coins through fresh wallets, hand to hand, but the nectar still flows from one hive: ten thousand puppets funded from one root weigh no more than one, and each opal on the string is priced by the knot it hangs from. To multiply influence, an attacker must multiply genuinely independent roots: separate money, histories, trails, so the cost grows with every bloc he wants.
